11894-the-mahabharata-of-krishna-dwaipay.title: Translated into English Prose from the Original Sanskrit Text
11894-the-mahabharata-of-krishna-dwaipay.creator: Kisari Mohan Ganguli
11894-the-mahabharata-of-krishna-dwaipay.description: A book by Kisari Mohan Ganguli. avas bearing their weapons and accompanied by Draupadi set out in a northerly direction. Indrasena and others, with servants numbering altogether fourteen, with their wives, followed them on swift cars. And the citizens learning of their departure became overwhelmed with sorrow, and began to censure Bhishma and Vidura and Drona and Gautama. And having met together they thus addressed one another fearlessly.

22280-views-and-reviews-essays-in-apprec.title: Views And Reviews Essays In Appreciation Literature
22280-views-and-reviews-essays-in-apprec.creator: W. E. Henley
22280-views-and-reviews-essays-in-apprec.description: A book by W. E. Henley. Andrew Lang is delightfully severe on those who 'cannot read Dickens,' but in truth it is only by accident that he is not himself of that unhappy persuasion. For Dickens the humourist he has a most uncompromising enthusiasm; for Dickens the artist in drama and romance he has as little sympathy as the most practical. Of the prose of _David Copperfield_ and _Our Mutual Friend_, the _Tale of Two Cities_ and _The Mystery of Edwin Drood_, he disdains to speak.

arxiv-2012-03699.title: A novel method to test particle ordering and final state alignment in helicity formalism
arxiv-2012-03699.creator: Mengzhen Wang, Yi Jiang, Yinrui Liu, Wenbin Qian, Xiaorui Lyu, Liming Zhang
arxiv-2012-03699.description: Abstract In this article, the importance is demonstrated of a proper choice of reference particles for decay angle definitions, when constructing partial-wave amplitude of multi-body decays using helicity formalism. This issue is often ignored in the standard use case of the helicity formalism.

arxiv-2104-08126.title: Exploiting Global and Local Attentions for Heavy Rain Removal on Single Images
arxiv-2104-08126.creator: DAC TUNG VU 1, JUAN LUIS GONZALEZ 1, MUNCHURL KIM 1
arxiv-2104-08126.description: Abstract Heavy rain removal from a single image is the task of simultaneously eliminating rain streaks and fog, which can dramatically degrade the quality of captured images. Most existing rain removal methods do not generalize well for the heavy rain case.

arxiv-2204-05045.title: SAL-CNN: Estimate the Remaining Useful Life of Bearings Using Time-frequency Information
arxiv-2204-05045.creator: Bingguo Liu, Zhuo Gao, Binghui Lu, Hangcheng Dong, Zeru An
arxiv-2204-05045.description: Abstract In modern industrial production, the prediction ability of remaining useful life (RUL) of bearings directly affects the safety and stability of the system. Traditional methods require rigorous physical modeling and perform poorly for complex systems. In this paper, an end-to-end RUL prediction method is proposed, which uses short-time Fourier transform (STFT) as preprocessing.

arxiv-2207-05114.title: Bayesian estimation of in-game home team win probability for National Basketball Association games
arxiv-2207-05114.creator: Jason T. Maddox, Ryan Sides, Jane L. Harvill
arxiv-2207-05114.description: Abstract Maddox et al., 2022 establish a new win probability estimation for college basketball and compared the results with previous methods of Stern, 1994 , Deshpande and Jensen, 2016 , and Benz, 2019 . This paper proposes modifications to the approach of Maddox et al., 2022 for the NBA game and investigate the performance of the model.

arxiv-2301-03270.title: A Survey of Learning-based Automated Program Repair Journal: TOSEM Volume: 0 0 1 0 CCS: Software and its engineering Software testing and debugging CCS: Software and its engineering Software testing and debugging
arxiv-2301-03270.creator: Quanjun Zhang, Chunrong Fang, Yuxiang Ma, Weisong Sun, Zhenyu Chen
arxiv-2301-03270.description: Abstract . Automated program repair (APR) aims to fix software bugs automatically and plays a crucial role in software development and maintenance. With the recent advances in deep learning (DL), an increasing number of APR techniques have been proposed to leverage neural networks to learn bug-fixing patterns from massive open-source code repositories.

arxiv-2402-00918.title: MUSTAN: Multi-scale Temporal Context as Attention for Robust Video Foreground Segmentation
arxiv-2402-00918.creator: Praveen Kumar Pokala, Jaya Sai Kiran Patibandla, Naveen Kumar Pandey, Balakrishna Reddy Pailla
arxiv-2402-00918.description: Abstract Video foreground segmentation (VFS) is an important computer vision task wherein one aims to segment the objects under motion from the background. Most of the current methods are image-based, i.e., rely only on spatial cues while ignoring motion cues. Therefore, they tend to overfit the training data and don’t generalize well to out-of-domain (OOD) distribution.

arxiv-2411-02219.title: Counting conjugacy classes of subgroups of PSL 2 ​ ( p ) {\rm PSL}_{2}(p)
arxiv-2411-02219.creator: Gareth A. Jones
arxiv-2411-02219.description: Abstract . We obtain formulae for the numbers of isomorphism and conjugacy classes of non-identity proper subgroups of the groups G = PSL 2 ​ ( p ) G={\rm PSL}_{2}(p) , p p prime, and for the numbers of those conjugacy classes which do or do not consist of self-normalising subgroups.

arxiv-2503-10450.title: Consistent multi-animal pose estimation in cattle using dynamic Kalman filter based tracking
arxiv-2503-10450.creator: Maarten Perneel* (ORCID 0000-0002-4831-5357), Ines Adriaens (ORCID 0000-0001-9768-2308), Ben Aernouts † \dagger (ORCID 0000-0001-6266-3019), Jan Verwaeren † \dagger (ORCID 0000-0001-9978-501X)
arxiv-2503-10450.description:
A 2025 arXiv research paper by Maarten Perneel* (ORCID 0000-0002-4831-5357), Ines Adriaens (ORCID 0000-0001-9768-2308), Ben Aernouts † \dagger (ORCID 0000-0001-6266-3019), Jan Verwaeren † \dagger (ORCID 0000-0001-9978-501X). Abstract

Over the past decade, studying animal behaviour with the help of computer vision has become more popular. Replacing human observers by computer vision lowers the cost of data collection and therefore allows to collect more extensive datasets. However, the majority of available computer vision algorithms to study animal behaviour is highly tailored towards a single research objective, limiting possibilities for data reuse.

arxiv-2602-20477.title: Search for pair production of heavy resonances in final states with a photon and large-radius jets in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2602-20477.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by . A search for the pair production of heavy spin- 1 / 2 1/2 or spin- 3 / 2 3/2 resonances ( \HepParticle \PQt *) in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV is presented. Data collected with the CMS detector at the CERN LHC from 2016 to 2018 corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv are used.

europmc-pmc8125338.title: New Antibiotics for Multidrug-Resistant Bacterial Strains: Latest Research Developments and Future Perspectives.
europmc-pmc8125338.creator: Terreni M, Taccani M, Pregnolato M.
europmc-pmc8125338.description: The present work aims to examine the worrying problem of antibiotic resistance and the emergence of multidrug-resistant bacterial strains, which have now become really common in hospitals and risk hindering the global control of infectious diseases. After a careful examination...

govdocs-archive_org-nsia-BurressLou_Burr.title: FBI Memorandum on Lou Burress Tip, December 13, 1963
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-BurressLou_Burr.creator: Federal Bureau of Investigation
govdocs-archive_org-nsia-BurressLou_Burr.description: FBI memorandum recording that Lou Burress of Dallas reported overhearing that Lee Harvey Oswald had applied for work at a New Orleans hardware company listing Jack Ruby as a reference.

gregory-the-great-selected-epistles-of-g.title: Selected Epistles of Gregory the Great, Books IX-XIV
gregory-the-great-selected-epistles-of-g.creator: Gregory the Great
gregory-the-great-selected-epistles-of-g.description: Selected Epistles of Gregory the Great, Books IX-XIV — Gregory the Great. From the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Series 2 edition (1892). A principal work of the early church, among the foundational texts of Christian antiquity.

pmc-10554037.title: SAT218 Refractory Hypocalcemia From Combined Autosomal Dominant Hypocalcemia Type 2 And Postsurgical Hypoparathyroidism
pmc-10554037.creator: Melda Sonmez Ince, Fadil Hannan, Nazanene Helen Esfandiari, Mehboob A Hussain, Megan R Haymart, Rajesh V Thakker, Gregory A Clines
pmc-10554037.description: Disclosure: M. Sonmez Ince: None. F. Hannan: None. N. Esfandiari: None. M. Hussain: None. M.R. Haymart: None. R.V. Thakker: None. G.A. Clines: None. Background: Autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 2 (ADH2), due to activating mutations in GNA11, is a rare disorder that causes hypocalcemia with low or inappropriately normal PTH. Postsurgical hypoparathyroidism (PSHP) is the most common etiology for hypoparathyroidism.

pmc-10654223.title: Agronomic performance and yield stability of extra-early maturing maize hybrids in multiple environments in the Sahel
pmc-10654223.creator: Laban Konate, Baffour Badu-Apraku, Mamadou Coulibaly, Abebe Menkir, M Nasser Laouali, Silvestro Meseka, Wende Mengesha
pmc-10654223.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Frequent occurrence of drought, heat, low soil fertility and Striga infestation are the main stress factors reducing maize yield in the Sahel. Adoption of stable multiple stress tolerant maize cultivars in the region is crucial for achieving food security. However, selection of a stable high yielding cultivar is complicated by genotype × environment interaction (GEI) due to differential responses to growing conditions.

pmc-11314823.title: Memristive True Random Number Generator for Security Applications
pmc-11314823.creator: Xianyue Zhao, Li-Wei Chen, Kefeng Li, Heidemarie Schmidt, Ilia Polian, Nan Du, Roman Sotner, Emanuele Piuzzi
pmc-11314823.description: This study explores memristor-based true random number generators (TRNGs) through their evolution and optimization, stemming from the concept of memristors first introduced by Leon Chua in 1971 and realized in 2008. We will consider memristor TRNGs coming from various entropy sources for producing high-quality random numbers. However, we must take into account both their strengths and weaknesses.

pmc-11331545.title: Allostreptopyrroles A–E, β-alkylpyrrole derivatives from an actinomycete Allostreptomyces sp. RD068384
pmc-11331545.creator: Marwa Elsbaey, Naoya Oku, Mohamed S A Abdel-Mottaleb, Yasuhiro Igarashi, Stefan Bräse
pmc-11331545.description: Five new β-alkylpyrrole derivatives, allostreptopyrroles A–E (1–5), were isolated from the culture broth of Allostreptomyces RD068384. Their structures were elucidated by 1D and 2D NMR spectroscopic analyses, HRESIMS, and chemical derivatization. The absolute configurations of compounds 2 and 3 were predicted by comparison of experimental and calculated specific rotation data.

pmc-11360341.title: DNA hydrogels and their derivatives in biomedical engineering applications
pmc-11360341.creator: Rui Wu, Wenting Li, Pu Yang, Naisi Shen, Anqi Yang, Xiangjun Liu, Yikun Ju, Lanjie Lei, Bairong Fang
pmc-11360341.description: Deoxyribonucleotide (DNA) is uniquely programmable and biocompatible, and exhibits unique appeal as a biomaterial as it can be precisely designed and programmed to construct arbitrary shapes. DNA hydrogels are polymer networks comprising cross-linked DNA strands. As DNA hydrogels present programmability, biocompatibility, and stimulus responsiveness, they are extensively explored in the field of biomedicine.

pmc-11476093.title: Inflammatory Trajectory of Type 2 Diabetes: Novel Opportunities for Early and Late Treatment
pmc-11476093.creator: Valeria Pellegrini, Rosalba La Grotta, Francesca Carreras, Angelica Giuliani, Jacopo Sabbatinelli, Fabiola Olivieri, Cesare Celeste Berra, Antonio Ceriello, Francesco Prattichizzo, Gil Leibowitz, Ruth B Caldwell
pmc-11476093.description: Low-grade inflammation (LGI) represents a key driver of type 2 diabetes (T2D) and its associated cardiovascular diseases (CVDs). Indeed, inflammatory markers such as hs-CRP and IL-6 predict the development of T2D and its complications, suggesting that LGI already increases before T2D diagnosis and remains elevated even after treatment.

pmc-11525708.title: Withaferin a modulation of microglia autophagy mitigates neuroinflammation and enhances cognitive function in POCD
pmc-11525708.creator: Haijun Hu, Bingbing Cao, Dan Huang, Yue Lin, Bin Zhou, Jun Ying, Lelin Huang, Lieliang Zhang
pmc-11525708.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). With the aging process of the global population and the development of medical technology, the cases of postoperative cognitive dysfunction (POCD) are also increasing. Due to the complexity of the pathogenesis, urgent treatment has been sought. Neuroinflammation induced by the accumulation of lipid droplets (LDs) in microglia has been closely watched in recent years and is also considered to be an important cause of nerve damage.

pmc-11546466.title: Disruption of RNA Splicing Increases Vulnerability of Cells to DNA-PK Inhibitors
pmc-11546466.creator: Anastasia P. Kovina, Artem V. Luzhin, Victor V. Tatarskiy, Dmitry A. Deriglazov, Natalia V. Petrova, Nadezhda V. Petrova, Liya G. Kondratyeva, Omar L. Kantidze, Sergey V. Razin, Artem K. Velichko
pmc-11546466.description: DNA-dependent protein kinase (DNA-PK) is a key effector of non-homologous end joining (NHEJ)-mediated double-strand break (DSB) repair. Since its identification, a substantial body of evidence has demonstrated that DNA-PK is frequently overexpressed in cancer, plays a critical role in tumor development and progression, and is associated with poor prognosis in cancer patients.

pmc-11615243.title: Mimicking on-water surface synthesis through micellar interfaces
pmc-11615243.creator: Anupam Prasoon, Shaik Ghouse, Nguyen Ngan Nguyen, Hyejung Yang, Alina Müller, Chandrasekhar Naisa, Silvia Paasch, Abdallh Herbawe, Muhannad Al Aiti, Gianaurelio Cuniberti, Eike Brunner, Xinliang Feng
pmc-11615243.description: The chemistry of the on-water surface, characterized by enhanced reactivity, distinct selectivity, and confined reaction geometry, offers significant potential for chemical and materials syntheses. However, the utilization of on-water surface synthesis is currently limited by the requirement for a stable air-water interface, which restricts its broader synthetic applications.

pmc-11643099.title: A Ku-Band Fully Differential Low-Power High-Input P1dB Low-Noise Amplifier
pmc-11643099.creator: Sang-Rok Lee, Joon-Hyung Kim, Min-Seok Baek, Choul-Young Kim
pmc-11643099.description: This paper introduces a Ku-band fully differential low-power high-input 1 dB compression point (P1dB) low-noise amplifier (LNA). A fully differential structure is employed to enhance the input P1dB, common-mode noise rejection, and second harmonic cancellation. The first stage adopts large transistors and is optimized for power consumption and noise figure (NF).

pmc-12364603.title: Breaking Boundaries: A Case Report of Giant Hiatal Hernia Housing Pancreas, Stomach, Small Bowel, and Colon
pmc-12364603.creator: Jonathan R Forrest, Urmimala Chaudhuri, Evans Konney, Drew J Triplett
pmc-12364603.description: Hiatal hernia (HH) is defined as the protrusion of abdominal contents through the esophageal hiatus of the diaphragm into the mediastinum. They are classified into categories I-IV. Type I, known as the sliding hernia, accounts for up to 90% of HH cases and are typically managed medically. Types II-IV combined account for less than 15% of HH cases.

pmc-12535496.title: Reverse arthroplasty compared to hemiarthroplasty and open reduction and internal fixation for displaced proximal humerus fracture in patients above 60: a Bayesian network meta-analysis
pmc-12535496.creator: Filippo Migliorini, Giuliano Sammaria, Luise Schäfer, Michael Memminger, Francesco Simeone, Nicola Maffulli
pmc-12535496.description: IntroductionThe present Bayesian network meta-analysis compared reverse total shoulder arthroplasty (rTSA) to hemiarthroplasty (HA) and open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) for displaced proximal humeral fractures (PHF) in patients above 60.MethodsThis study was conducted according to the PRISMA extension statement for reporting systematic reviews incorporating network meta-analyses of healthcare interventions.

pmc-12573160.title: Impact of Azobenzene Side Chains on the Ultraviolet–Visible and Fluorescence Properties of Coumarin Derivatives
pmc-12573160.creator: Yasemin Akdis, Akin Akdag
pmc-12573160.description: The effect of photoswitchable compounds on the light-emitting properties of nanoparticles has been drawing increasing attention. To investigate the effect of photoswitchable azobenzene units on the photophysical properties of coumarin, a biologically relevant fluorophore, photoresponsive azobenzene-coumarin derivatives were synthesized and characterized.

pmc-12590581.title: Prevalence, microbiological features, and risk factors for periprosthetic joint infections in oncologic patients following tumor resection and megaprosthetic reconstruction
pmc-12590581.creator: Andreas G. Tsantes, Dimitrios V. Papadopoulos, Stavros Goumenos, Eleni Petrou, Ioannis G. Trikoupis, Anastasios Roustemis, Alexandra Mpakosi, Petros Ioannou, Christos Koutserimpas, Panayiotis Gavriil, Daniele Piovani, Stefanos Bonovas, Panayiotis J. Papagelopoulos, Athanasios Tsakris, Argirios E. Ts
pmc-12590581.description: Periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) after tumor resection and megaprosthetic reconstruction of bone defects is a common complication. The purpose of this study was to evaluate the prevalence of these infections, assess their microbiological profile, and identify perioperative risk factors for these complications.

pmc-12743983.title: Anterior Ankle Soft Tissue Thickness and Infection Risk after Total Ankle Arthroplasty
pmc-12743983.creator: Vivek Nair, Matthew Cederman, Dylan Moran, Robert Dean, Paul Fortin, Zein El-Zein
pmc-12743983.description: Research Type:Level 3 - Retrospective cohort study, Case-control study, Meta-analysis of Level 3 studiesIntroduction/Purpose:Total ankle arthroplasty (TAA) has become a widely utilized technique for managing end-stage ankle arthritis, yet complications persist. One recently identified predictor of complications is the soft tissue envelope surrounding the ankle.

pmc-12852236.title: Sustained Delivery of Chondrogenic Molecules Using Sugar Glass Nanoparticle-Integrated Fibrous Scaffolds for Cartilage Tissue Engineering
pmc-12852236.creator: To Wang, Yiwei Dong, Marcus T. Cicerone, Wan-Ju Li
pmc-12852236.description: PurposeBiomaterial scaffolds capable of controlled release of bioactive molecules hold significant potential in tissue engineering, offering a promising avenue to enhance tissue regeneration. They provide localized and sustained delivery of biological cues to direct stem cell differentiation while creating a three-dimensional microenvironment that supports cell adhesion and growth.

pmc-13380059.title: Neurogenic heterotopic ossification: from molecular mechanisms to clinical treatment
pmc-13380059.creator: Zhengqiang Yuan, Linbin Xu, Juehong Li, Cunyi Fan
pmc-13380059.description: Neurogenic heterotopic ossification (NHO), a disabling complication of severe central nervous system injuries, involves ectopic periarticular bone formation that causes profound functional impairments and reduced quality of life. This review highlights recent advances in NHO, especially focusing on the neuro-immune-osteogenic axis.

pmc-13422634.title: Strength of religious faith is associated with altered sense of agency during multisensory conflict
pmc-13422634.creator: Gerardo Salvato, Alara France, Manuela Sellitto, Martina Corgnati, Ugo Volli, Luigi Pizzamiglio, Gabriella Bottini

pmc-13560235.title: Healthcare workers’ knowledge and acceptance of the malaria vaccine in the Nanoro Health District of Burkina Faso: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13560235.creator: Jean-Vincent Lamien, Bérenger Kaboré, Karim Derra, Zanma Michaël John Compaoré, Guétawendé Job Wilfried Nassa, Aimé Parfait Korou Yaro, Bapouguini Raymond Gbangou, Raffaella Ravinetto, Halidou Tinto, Carine Dochez

pmc-13572900.title: Assessment of Pain Characteristics, Attribution, and Nociplasticity in Patients With Inflammatory Myopathies: An International Survey Study
pmc-13572900.creator: Mohammad Radaideh, Juan Schmukler, Alexander Best, Joshlean Fair, Manuel Lubinus, Yvonne C Lee, Didem Saygin
pmc-13572900.description: ObjectiveIdiopathic inflammatory myopathies (IIMs) have historically been viewed to cause painless weakness and are therefore poorly understood. We aimed to report pain characteristics in patients with IIMs and estimate the contributions of fibromyalgia and common painful comorbidities to pain intensity.MethodsAn international electronic survey was circulated to individuals who self‐reported IIMs and pain attributable to myositis.
